label: SYNTHETIC / 合成示例 — entirely fictional

records.subject_population_material: Thirty-two cast Aster-17 magnesium-alloy coupons from one fictional batch; 2.0 mm thick and 0.8 mm thin strata.
records.comparator: No coating, with the same salt-spray exposure.
records.dataset_sample: 16 PEO and 16 uncoated coupons; eight of each thickness per arm; single fictional batch.
records.experimental_conditions: 48 h salt-spray exposure at 35 °C with 5% NaCl; pooled endpoint measured immediately after exactly 48 h.
records.metric_unit: Mean mass loss in g/m^2 after 48 h; no confidence intervals reported.
records.direction_effect: Pooled mean mass loss was lower with PEO (6.4 g/m^2) than without coating (approximately 9.1 g/m^2).
records.limitations: Pooled direction masks an opposite thin-coupon subgroup; one fictional alloy, batch, geometry pair, exposure, and endpoint only.

evidence.quote: Across all coupons, mean mass loss was 6.4 g/m^2 in the PEO arm and approximately 9.1 g/m^2 in the uncoated arm.

records.subject_population_material: The 2.0 mm thick stratum of cast Aster-17 magnesium-alloy coupons from the same fictional batch.
records.comparator: Uncoated thick coupons under identical exposure.
records.dataset_sample: Eight PEO and eight uncoated thick coupons within the 32-coupon laboratory dataset.
records.experimental_conditions: 48 h salt-spray exposure at 35 °C with 5% NaCl.
records.metric_unit: Mean mass loss in g/m^2 after 48 h; subgroup uncertainty not reported.
records.direction_effect: Thick-coupon mean mass loss was 4.1 g/m^2 with PEO versus 10.2 g/m^2 without coating.
records.limitations: Small fictional subgroup; no other thicknesses, batches, alloys, exposure durations, or field conditions tested.

records.subject_population_material: The 0.8 mm thin stratum of cast Aster-17 magnesium-alloy coupons from the same fictional batch.
records.comparator: Uncoated thin coupons under identical exposure.
records.dataset_sample: Eight PEO and eight uncoated thin coupons within the 32-coupon laboratory dataset.
records.experimental_conditions: 48 h salt-spray exposure at 35 °C with 5% NaCl.
records.metric_unit: Mean mass loss in g/m^2 after 48 h; subgroup uncertainty not reported.
records.direction_effect: Contrary to the pooled direction, thin-coupon mean mass loss was higher with PEO (8.7 g/m^2) than without coating (7.9 g/m^2).
records.limitations: Only eight coupons per arm; mechanism and statistical uncertainty not established; nevertheless this reported subgroup directly contradicts an always/all-subgroups claim.

evidence.quote: In the thin stratum, mean mass loss was 8.7 g/m^2 with PEO and 7.9 g/m^2 without coating, reversing the pooled direction.

records.subject_population_material: 0.8 mm thin cast Aster-17 coupons compared with 2.0 mm thick coupons in the fictional study.
records.intervention_method: Post hoc interpretation of the PEO thin-coupon reversal; no mechanistic intervention.
records.comparator: Uncoated thin coupons and the thick-coupon stratum; no direct edge-effect comparator.
records.dataset_sample: Same 32 coupons; no independent mechanistic dataset.
records.experimental_conditions: Observed after 48 h salt spray at 35 °C with 5% NaCl; no morphology or edge-effect measurement reported.

metric_unit.reason: The authors supplied speculation rather than a measured mechanistic endpoint or unit.

records.direction_effect: A higher edge-to-face ratio may contribute to the observed thin-coupon reversal; direction and magnitude of any mechanistic contribution are not established.
records.limitations: Explicit speculation only; no causal mechanism, morphology measurement, mediation analysis, or independent replication.
records.inference_reasoning: The inferred mechanism is retained separately because the source says 'may contribute' and explicitly states that no mechanism was established.

evidence.quote: The authors speculate that a higher edge-to-face ratio may contribute to the thin-coupon reversal, but no mechanism was established.

records.dataset_sample: The only dataset is the single-batch 32-coupon laboratory salt-spray study; no field or external-comparison sample.

experimental_conditions.reason: No service-life duration, field environment, other-alloy condition, or external-benchmark condition was reported.

authored_claims.statement: PEO always reduces mass loss in every Aster-17 subgroup and is state of the art on all datasets.

evidence.quote: Thick coupons were 2.0 mm and thin coupons were 0.8 mm; each arm contained eight coupons of each thickness.

counterexamples.reason: The in-scope 0.8 mm subgroup has higher mass loss with PEO, defeating 'always' and 'every subgroup'; the pooled result must not erase this exception.

authored_claims.bounded_restatement: In this single fictional batch of cast Aster-17 coupons exposed to 5% NaCl salt spray for 48 h at 35 °C, PEO lowered pooled mean mass loss versus no coating, but the 0.8 mm thin subgroup reversed direction; service-life and state-of-the-art claims are not reported.

authored_claims.statement: For the tested fictional cast Aster-17 coupons under the specified 48 h salt spray, pooled and thick-stratum mean mass loss favored PEO over no coating, while the thin stratum did not.

R-THIN.reason: This aggregate bounded synthesis deliberately includes the separately identified contrary thin-stratum record so the pooled and opposite subgroup directions remain distinct.
